name: h1_scenarios
description: Two registered alternative constructions, each matched to the circle-based H0 at a single time point (marginal mean and covariance).
note: 本文件是冻结设计的可读快照；权威值在 governance 对象中。

shape_change.matched_to: N_CIRCLE null (same latent path, noise scale 0.08)

mean_shift.construction: mean shift of magnitude 0.5 in direction v(θ), θ ~ U(0,1) after τ_true
mean_shift.matched_to: N_CIRCLE null (single-time-point marginal mean and covariance)

critical_value.definition: empirical 0.95 quantile of the null scan statistic within the matched H0 cell

design.joint_success: detection AND localization; missed trials stay in the denominator
